_template_instructions: TEMPLATE ONLY (no secrets, no real values). Copy to docs/mvp-recovery/qgate-05/custody/freeze-commitment.json on the HUB branch qgate-05/custody-1 (outside the candidate checkout; the workflow reads that branch, not the hub default branch) AFTER the Owner approves the freeze record and BEFORE the run branch is pushed. Push it ONCE; never force-push or amend. Replace every <...>. Delete this key in the real file. Never edit the real file after commit; a changed candidate is a new commitment, new freeze record and a new custody file (freeze-commitment.v2.json).
status: PROPOSED custody anchor; not a certification, Qualification verdict, Tier 1, Q7, release or production authorization
qualification_revision: <40-hex Qualification commit that the run branch will point at; the workflow must see GITHUB_SHA equal to this>
candidate_commitment_sha256: <64-hex sha256 of the commitment file bytes (gate sha256_file); the workflow recomputes this value and passes it to the gate as --expect-commitment-sha256; there is no workflow input>

freeze_record.path: <hub path of the approved freeze record, e.g. docs/mvp-recovery/qgate-05/custody/freeze-record.json>

gate_file_sha256: <64-hex of tools/mvp_acceptance_gate.py at qualification_revision (listed in the commitment; the workflow asserts equality)>

recorded_by.role: <e.g. Qualification Owner (AI session, same lineage; no formal independence)>

recorded_at_utc: <YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, taken when the custody commit is made>

rule.order: This record is committed to the hub (outside the candidate checkout) BEFORE the run branch is pushed and BEFORE the single run.
workflow_assertions: sha256 of commitment_file at GITHUB_SHA, recomputed in the job, equals candidate_commitment_sha256 in this record, read from the hub branch qgate-05/custody-1 (resolved head sha recorded in the run evidence)
the tuple resolved by the job equals the tuple pin file and the identity inputs (both inside the commitment)
rule.mismatch: any mismatch makes the run INCOMPLETE/REJECT per the gate; nothing is repaired in place
rule.second_channel: the same candidate_commitment_sha256 is also posted as an Issue #215 comment (see ISSUE-COMMENT.template.md) before the run

limits: Same-lineage AI roles: this custody record is tamper-evident (hub git history and the GitHub comment timestamp), not independent certification.
It proves which candidate was declared before the run; it does not prove the candidate is correct.
